about: The parts of GC's sources that the 28 October 2026 reading did not read in full, read on 3 November 2026 (the index record's correction under gc-chain-review-28-october-2026). Each change is read from the version the chain's fingerprint recorded (reading.json's recorded_commit and recorded_path) to the version GC refreshed it at (6c84c2d90). Counts are git diff --numstat between those two versions. Author reading, not independent acceptance.

The register gained D46-D68, the Ren-as-trigger wording was replaced, terms were restated (R21, R36) and links moved to history. The refreshes stand.

Besides that section's rewrite to the alignment of the joint selection (AJ, 24 October 2026), the changes are new goals, links moved to history and the record ids R35 E4 renamed. M20 cites the section for active directions and completed results and states none of its wording. The refresh stands.
